data.name: Pawn Within: Two Fates
data.detailed_description:
In the vast sea of stars, engage in a tactical battle right at your fingertips.

This is a tabletop simulation game that combines classic tactical SRPG combat, match-3 synthesis, and Skill Build. Set aboard a distant starship, you will control the hero Luca and his companions across an intricate magical board. On grid-based battlefields filled with obstacles and enemies, you will cast powerful magic through clever positioning and unique equipment combinations to solve endless tactical challenges.

Game Features

🎯 Assemble your skill disk!

The unique skill disk system lets you freely customize your playstyle. Collect sector-shaped pieces to build your own exclusive skill combinations. Before each battle, adapt your setup to different stages and enemy types and enjoy deep strategic deck-building.

🔄 Spin your skill disk!

As your wheel stops, one or more skills enter your inventory. Keep them or fuse them? The choice is yours. This mechanic adds unpredictability and excitement to every battle, forcing you to adapt on the fly and keep each encounter fresh.

⚡ Manage your action points wisely!

The innovative action point system breaks traditional SRPG limits. Move or spin? Every choice matters. Properly allocating every action point is the key to victory. Will you play aggressively or defensively? Your AP management will decide the outcome.

🔷 Three combined skills are stronger than one!

Our groundbreaking match-3 synthesis system lets you upgrade skills in combat. Match identical skill icons to create higher-tier abilities with more powerful effects. Strategy and luck come together to make skill growth fun and rewarding.

🌟 Master every skill!

Dozens of unique effects await discovery, from basic attacks to elemental skills of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth. Skills chain together in powerful combinations. Mix and match freely to unlock secret synergies and create your own one-of-a-kind build.

🦸 Warrior! Mage! Assassin! Hunter! Priest! Druid! Robot!

Multiple playable heroes, each with unique skill trees, passive abilities, and combat styles. From all-around warriors to immune robots, assemble your favorite team and experience completely different playstyles.

👹 Nearly unbeatable bosses!

At the end of each chapter await powerful, unique bosses. Each has distinct mechanics, skills, and phase shifts. Study their patterns, plan your tactics, and defeat them to prove your strategic skill.

♟️ Realistic chess-piece animations!

Beautifully crafted chess animations bring every move, attack, and hit to life, delivering a truly immersive tabletop experience.

data.short_description: A tabletop SRPG blending match-3, Skill Construction & tactics. Collect parts to craft skill discs, spin for random abilities, then merge or keep them. Equip gear, maneuver on grids, cast spells, and lead unique heroes to defeat challenging bosses in this strategic adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.40 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 470 / GeForce GTX 960 - 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 5700 / GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
